## Current Formula v3.1
- HPβCD / cyclodextrin: odor capture
- Zinc PCA: odor neutralization
- Triethyl Citrate: odor-control support
- Zinc Gluconate: odor-control / anti-regrowth support
- Glycerine-free

## Approved product claims
- Pocket-sized fabric odor mist
- Fabric-only
- Up to 8 hours odor protection on fabric under normal office/commute conditions
- Fast-drying, low-fragrance, residue-conscious formula
- Designed for cotton, polyester, denim and wool with spot testing for delicate items
- Made in Hyderabad, India

## Claims to avoid
- Do not call it a skin deodorant or antiperspirant.
- Do not claim universal stain-proofing across every fabric.
- Do not claim it kills bacteria unless a current test/certification supports that exact claim.
- Do not claim an instant or guaranteed 10-second cure.
- Do not invent review counts, ratings, certifications, clinical efficacy or test results.
